::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 26. 1865  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55384 (1): P. 409
:::

Dear Miss Yonge	
The [cheque](organizations/other_160.qmd) for £200 was sent you last night. My clerk reminded that former remittances were so made. The monthly payments will be sent the same way.

[I](people/person_939.qmd)am going to have the second [chapter](organizations/other_177.qmd) as the first set up in type. I will venture to go over it and make any suggestions that strike me.

Yours ever faithfully
A. Macmillan
